The imagery of a woman gazing at the night sky, seeking knowledge, has been a recurring theme in Islamic literature and poetry. This is reflected in the many verses in the Quran that celebrate the wonders of the universe and encourage humans to seek knowledge and wisdom.

The name is a constant reminder of the importance of curiosity, questioning, and learning in one's spiritual journey.
